records.name: Sword
records.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: reusable transparent pixel-art sword for an existing tactical RPG sprite pipeline.
Remake ONLY the sword from the reference image, isolated and completely visible, vertically upright with tip at top and grip at bottom. Preserve the recognizable design: very long slender straight pointed crystalline blade tapering smoothly to a needle tip; ice-blue inner facet and silver-white cutting edges; several small jagged crystal fins near the blade's lower quarter; elegant silver-white curling wing-like guard around a small circular jewel/flower at the hilt; dark navy wrapped grip with small ice-blue sections; a small pointed crystal pommel. It is a one-handed longsword, not a broad greatsword or staff. Keep guard reasonably compact and readable at a final total sword length of about 60 pixels.
Production palette EXACTLY three solid colors: deep navy #172638 for outlines/grip/shadows, warm ivory #e4e1c8 for silver edges/guard, pale ice blue #a7d7e5 for the crystalline blade. Pixel-art illustration with crisp stair-step edges, coherent facets, no antialias blur or gradients. Ornament silhouette must remain complete.
No star, mist, glow, frost particles, background scenery, shadow, hand, character, text, border or UI. True transparent background with generous margins and no clipping.

Read the white original sword as the weapon, not another arm. Keep exactly TWO arms, TWO legs and ONE sword per figure. Full complete figures including entire sword/hair/feet in six isolated equal cells with large transparent gaps and generous margins. Same character identity and scale throughout, poses vertically registered as in source. Clean hard pixel edges, no blur. No background, ground shadow, text, labels, grid, border, extra figure or spell effects.
